data.name: Lawn Care Clicker Deluxe
data.detailed_description:
Lawn Care Clicker Deluxe

Welcome to Lawn Care Clicker Deluxe — the world’s most overgrown idle adventure, where the grass is always greener… until you mow it.

Grab your mower, sharpen your shears, and embrace the meditative chaos of tending your virtual turf empire. This is more than just clicking grass — it’s a journey of growth, glory, and the occasional UFO watering your yard for reasons we still can’t explain.

You’ll start with a humble patch of weeds and a dream. Through sweat, clicks, and the occasional llama snack attack, you’ll evolve from Average Joe with a mower to Supreme Overseer of Turf Perfection. Because in Lawn Care Clicker Deluxe, every blade matters — and every upgrade takes you one step closer to suburban enlightenment.

🌿 Grow Your Way to Glory

Click to trim, collect clippings, and upgrade your tools. From rusty push mowers to futuristic hover trimmers, your arsenal of grass-obliterating power only gets stronger.

☀️ Seasonal Shenanigans

Spring sprouts hope. Summer brings prosperity. Fall hides secrets beneath piles of crunchy leaves. And winter… well, let’s just say your snowblower has opinions.

💸 Upgrade Everything

Invest in mower blades, fertilizer drones, sprinkler satellites, and maybe even the concept of time itself. Because nothing says “progress” like faster grass regrowth.

🧠 Achievement Unlocked: Inner Peace

Whether you’re clicking obsessively or letting the idle gains roll in, Lawn Care Clicker Deluxe is the perfect blend of chill vibes and compulsive satisfaction. It’s oddly soothing, delightfully absurd, and sneakily deep.

Key Features

  • 🪓 Over 100 upgrades spanning tools, skills, and weird backyard tech

  • 🕹️ Steam Achievements, leaderboards, and cloud saves

  • 🎨 Beautiful pixel-art style with hand-crafted seasonal environments

  • 🦙 Llamas. So many llamas.

  • 🛸 And yes, a UFO that waters your lawn.

Mow your way to mindfulness.
Click your way to chaos.
Become the legend your lawn deserves.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual-core 1.8 GHz (e.g. Intel Core 2 Duo / early i3
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 or equivalent (WebGL-capable; hardware acceleration on)
  • Storage: 450 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any onboard audio
  • VR Support: Not Supported
